criteria.statement: Approved Arcana Compose deployment executes once, reports persisted phases, waits for healthy, and finishes healthy and in_sync.
Rejected deployment creates no execution and makes no runtime change; approval re-evaluates current policy.
One linkable UI shows unit/endpoint, desired hash, artifact digest, policy, phases, logs, health, drift, safe failure, observation, and completion.
Healthcheck timeout offers rollback to an explicit previous artifact through a fresh policy-checked intent that respects protected approval.
Restart/reconcile and delayed or duplicate observations preserve the newest healthy in_sync state.
Stored stdout and stderr redact every retained version of each referenced secret before stream selection or tailing.
Deployment history and each run/log view have stable navigable URLs and rollback target links.
